emergence.summary: An autosomal-dominant vascular-dysplasia syndrome in which loss of an endothelial vascular-QUIESCENCE brake produces fragile, dilated, direct artery-to-vein connections -- mucocutaneous telangiectasias (recurrent epistaxis, gastrointestinal bleeding, anaemia) and visceral arteriovenous malformations (pulmonary, hepatic, cerebral). The BMP9/10 ligands (GDF2/BMP10) signal through the endothelial type-I receptor ALK1 (ACVRL1) with the co-receptor endoglin (ENG) to phosphorylate SMAD1/5/8 -- the pathway that holds endothelium QUIESCENT (the BRAKE on endothelial activation / aberrant angiogenesis). Heterozygous LOF of ENG (HHT1) or ACVRL1 (HHT2) (haploinsufficiency) lowers BMP9/10-ALK1-ENG signalling -> the quiescence brake is released -> endothelial activation and arteriovenous malformation (axis UP). Read as a released BRAKE on endothelial quiescence, opening a NEW endothelial / TGF-beta-superfamily VASCULAR axis (the receptor-signalling contrast to the kit's metabolite / transport / inflammasome / mTOR / HIF released-brake reads), and the kit's FIFTH two-causal-gene convergence (after HCM, sitosterolaemia, cystinuria, TSC) -- two obligate partners (ALK1 receptor + endoglin co-receptor) of ONE quiescence pathway, LOF of EITHER releasing the same brake; ENG primary by barrier depth (gamma 1.5009 vs ACVRL1 1.4681). CRITICAL HONESTY (this is a DOWNGRADED read -- the kit does NOT force a drug): there is at present NO approved targeted therapy for HHT anywhere in the world. The emerged switch FORCES the corrective DIRECTION = restore the BMP9/10-ALK1-ENG quiescence brake (re-impose endothelial quiescence), but NO approved agent does this; ALK1-agonist / BMP9-mimetic / ENG- or ACVRL1-restoration approaches are investigational. The only clinically-evidenced agents are DOWNSTREAM, OFF-LABEL ANTI-ANGIOGENICS that lower the VEGF-driven angiogenic over-drive secondary to the lost brake -- bevacizumab (anti-VEGF antibody, used off-label) and pomalidomide (an immunomodulatory anti-angiogenic; approved for multiple myeloma / Kaposi sarcoma, used OFF-LABEL for HHT, with randomised-trial evidence for epistaxis in the PATH-HHT study). These act DOWNSTREAM of the broken brake and do NOT restore ENG/ACVRL1, so each is an INDIRECT (off-causal-gene, VEGFA-target) lever graded [O] by the indirect-lever honesty gate, and explicitly NOT approved for HHT. So unlike the kit's other resolved diseases, HHT does NOT re-derive an approved targeted drug (none exists): it opens the vascular axis, fixes the corrective DIRECTION (restore the brake), and records honestly that current medicine offers only downstream off-label anti-angiogenics -- a deliberate DIVERGENCE between the switch logic and clinical reality, kept transparent rather than papered over (ledger B25). The gamma reads the ENG / ACVRL1 locus switch STRUCTURE; the disease lesions are haploinsufficiency (truncating / missense / deletion) coding/splice changes, outside the promoter firewall. SMAD4-related combined juvenile-polyposis-HHT is a distinct genotype, named-not-conflated. Magnitude [O].

per_gene.note: ENG encodes endoglin, the endothelial TGF-beta/BMP9 co-receptor that, with ALK1 (ACVRL1), transduces BMP9/10 -> SMAD1/5/8 signalling to maintain vascular QUIESCENCE -- a BRAKE on endothelial activation and aberrant angiogenesis. Heterozygous LOF (haploinsufficiency) lowers that signalling -> the quiescence brake is released -> telangiectasias and arteriovenous malformations (axis UP); HHT type 1. 9q34.11, OMIM 131195; HHT1 OMIM 187300. NCBI official symbol ENG. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; the truncating/missense/deletion lesions are outside the promoter firewall.
per_gene.src: McAllister 1994 Nat Genet 8:345 (ENG mutations cause HHT1); David 2007 Blood 109:1953 and Castonguay 2011 J Biol Chem 286:30034 (BMP9 signals via ALK1/endoglin to maintain endothelial quiescence)

grades.perturbation_direction: [F] forced by (role x mechanism); cited biology

per_gene.note: ACVRL1 encodes ALK1 (activin receptor-like kinase 1), the endothelial type-I receptor for BMP9/10 that phosphorylates SMAD1/5/8 -- the obligate signalling partner of endoglin in the SAME vascular-quiescence pathway, so heterozygous LOF (haploinsufficiency) of ACVRL1 releases the same brake just as ENG loss does -> telangiectasias and arteriovenous malformations (axis UP); HHT type 2. 12q13.13, OMIM 601284; HHT2 OMIM 600376. NCBI official symbol ACVRL1. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; coding/splice lesions are outside the promoter firewall.
per_gene.src: Johnson 1996 Nat Genet 13:189 (ACVRL1/ALK1 mutations cause HHT2); Urness 2000 Nat Genet 26:328 (Acvrl1-null endothelium forms arteriovenous malformations)

falsifiers.claim: ENG/ACVRL1 LOF releases the BMP9/10-ALK1 vascular-quiescence brake (endothelial activation UP -> AVMs)
falsifiers.falsifier: an ENG or ACVRL1 LOF allele that INCREASED BMP9/10-ALK1-SMAD1/5/8 signalling or SUPPRESSED endothelial activation / arteriovenous-malformation formation would refute the released-brake (axis UP) direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: endothelial SMAD1/5/8 phosphorylation and arteriovenous-malformation / telangiectasia burden in Eng- or Acvrl1-haploinsufficient endothelium (mouse model, patient telangiectasia tissue)

falsifiers.claim: restoring BMP9/10-ALK1-ENG signalling (restrain by net axis effect) is the CORRECTIVE direction
falsifiers.falsifier: if restoring ALK1/endoglin signalling (BMP9/10 supplementation, ALK1 agonism, ENG/ACVRL1 restoration) INCREASED arteriovenous-malformation burden or endothelial activation, the restore-the-brake lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: arteriovenous-malformation burden / endothelial-activation markers in response to ALK1/endoglin-pathway restoration in HHT models (Eng/Acvrl1 mutant mouse)

falsifiers.claim: the clinically-used anti-angiogenics act DOWNSTREAM (do NOT restore the causal ENG/ACVRL1 brake)
falsifiers.falsifier: if bevacizumab or pomalidomide were shown to RESTORE ENG/ACVRL1-BMP9/10-ALK1-SMAD1/5/8 signalling (not merely lower downstream VEGF / angiogenesis), the INDIRECT [O] classification of those levers would be wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: endothelial SMAD1/5/8 phosphorylation / ALK1-pathway activity under anti-VEGF or pomalidomide exposure vs ENG/ACVRL1 status (endothelial cells, HHT models)
